body.name: Canonical PDAG component enumerator with breadth-first fallback
body.construction: Given \(C=(G,\Pi)\), construct the canonical background PDAG \(\mathcal P_C\) from \(\texttt{def:canonical-background-pdag}\), compute its Meek closure, and apply the consistent-extension enumerator of \(\texttt{lem:pdag-consistent-extension-enumeration}\). For every emitted DAG \(H\), emit the canonical state \(\mathsf L_C(H)\) from \(\texttt{def:canonical-partition-lift}\); the emitted set is \(\operatorname{Enum}(C)\). The primary procedure is exact-once without state memoization. When a shortest certificate is requested, repeatedly scan for a covered arrow that disagrees with \(H\), reverse it, and canonically lift each intermediate graph. As a simple fallback, initialize a queue and exact visited set with \(C\), apply every defined \(\operatorname{rev}_{i\to j}\), append each unvisited state, and stop when the queue is empty.
